WITH customers AS (
    SELECT customer_id FROM main.customer_nodes
    UNION
    SELECT customer_id FROM main.customer_transactions
),
transaction_profile AS (
    SELECT
        substr(txn_date, 1, 7) AS month,
        txn_type,
        COUNT(*) AS transactions,
        COUNT(DISTINCT customer_id) AS transacting_customers,
        COUNT(*) - COUNT(txn_amount) AS missing_amounts
    FROM main.customer_transactions
    GROUP BY substr(txn_date, 1, 7), txn_type
)
SELECT *,
       (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM customers) AS all_customers,
       (SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT customer_id) FROM main.customer_nodes) AS node_customers,
       (SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT customer_id) FROM main.customer_transactions) AS distinct_transaction_customers,
       (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM main.customer_nodes) AS node_rows
FROM transaction_profile
ORDER BY month, txn_type

arguments.sql:
WITH RECURSIVE months(month_start) AS (
    VALUES ('2020-01-01')
    UNION ALL
    SELECT date(month_start, '+1 month')
    FROM months
    WHERE month_start < '2020-12-01'
),
customers AS (
    SELECT customer_id FROM main.customer_nodes
    UNION
    SELECT customer_id FROM main.customer_transactions
),
monthly_transactions AS (
    SELECT
        customer_id,
        date(txn_date, 'start of month') AS month_start,
        SUM(CASE txn_type
            WHEN 'deposit' THEN txn_amount
            WHEN 'withdrawal' THEN -txn_amount
        END) AS balance
    FROM main.customer_transactions
    WHERE txn_date >= '2020-01-01'
      AND txn_date < '2021-01-01'
      AND txn_type IN ('deposit', 'withdrawal')
    GROUP BY customer_id, date(txn_date, 'start of month')
),
customer_month_balances AS (
    SELECT
        months.month_start,
        COALESCE(monthly_transactions.balance, 0) AS balance
    FROM months
    CROSS JOIN customers
    LEFT JOIN monthly_transactions
        ON monthly_transactions.month_start = months.month_start
       AND monthly_transactions.customer_id = customers.customer_id
),
monthly_summary AS (
    SELECT
        month_start,
        COUNT(CASE WHEN balance > 0 THEN 1 END) AS positive_customer_count,
        AVG(balance) AS average_balance
    FROM customer_month_balances
    GROUP BY month_start
),
ranked_months AS (
    SELECT
        month_start,
        positive_customer_count,
        average_balance,
        RANK() OVER (ORDER BY positive_customer_count DESC) AS highest_rank,
        RANK() OVER (ORDER BY positive_customer_count ASC) AS lowest_rank
    FROM monthly_summary
)
SELECT
    substr(highest.month_start, 1, 7) AS highest_count_month,
    highest.positive_customer_count AS highest_positive_customer_count,
    highest.average_balance AS highest_month_average_balance,
    substr(lowest.month_start, 1, 7) AS lowest_count_month,
    lowest.positive_customer_count AS lowest_positive_customer_count,
    lowest.average_balance AS lowest_month_average_balance,
    highest.average_balance - lowest.average_balance AS average_balance_difference
FROM ranked_months AS highest
CROSS JOIN ranked_months AS lowest
WHERE highest.highest_rank = 1
  AND lowest.lowest_rank = 1
ORDER BY highest.month_start, lowest.month_start
